name: regex-leaf-corpus-v1
note: Sticky match at offset 0 with each leaf's flags; answers are V8 and JavaScriptCore agreeing (2 reps each). want: UTF-8 match end, null = no match, ENC = ends inside a surrogate pair, AMB = engines disagree, SYN = syntax error. A third element, when present, is the answer for the leaf read with u (DIALECT reading).
